## Validation

- [ ] MCP tests pass.
- [ ] Shared bridge tests pass.
- [ ] Provider bundle tests pass when provider artifacts are affected.
- [ ] Relevant Autodesk live testing is documented, or the reason it was not run is stated.
- [ ] No Autodesk document, binary, token, descriptor, personal path, or sensitive log is included.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO sign-off.
